svg.title: Different surface forms of the same protected task
svg.desc: The protected problem starts with 40 liters, loses 5 liters per hour, and asks what remains after 6 hours. Three examples preserve the task: liters changed to L, a rephrased English prompt, and an Armenian translation. They are constructed derivatives, not independent problems that only share a topic.
svg.text: A tank contains 40 liters of water and loses 5 liters per hour.
A tank contains 40 L of water and loses 5 L per hour.
Start with 40 liters in a tank. Drain 5 liters each hour.
How much is left after 6 hours?
Բաքում կա 40 լիտր ջուր։ Ամեն ժամ դրանից հոսում է 5 լիտր։
